title: Cyber Monday Soundbar Deals 2026: Price Targets for 12 Bars
metaDescription: Cyber Monday 2026 is November 30. A soundbar deal is real when it beats the usual low price, e.g. a Sonos Arc Ultra at $900 or less. Targets for 12 bars.
h1: Cyber Monday Soundbar Deals 2026: Price Targets
intro:
Cyber Monday 2026 falls on **Monday, November 30**, three days after Black Friday (November 27). Rather than list sale prices that change by the hour, this page gives a **price target for 12 popular soundbars**: the low end of the street-price band we track for each. A Cyber Monday price at or below that target is a real deal; anything above it is a normal price with a sale banner.

We do not show live prices, and we have not checked every retailer's current offer. Check the current price on the retailer's page before you buy. Targets updated November 27, 2026; this page will be retired after the holiday season.
quickAnswer: Buy a soundbar on Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026) only if it beats its usual low price: **Sonos Arc Ultra at $900 or less, Sonos Beam (Gen 2) $400 or less, Bose Smart Ultra $700 or less, Samsung HW-Q990F $1,500 or less, JBL Bar 1000 $800 or less, Vizio Elevate $350 or less.** Pick the bar that fits your room first; a discount on the wrong bar is not a deal.
picksHeading: Soundbars Worth Buying on Cyber Monday

picks.body: The Arc Ultra scores **88/100**, the highest of the bars on this page, and is listed as 9.1.4 from 14 drivers with Dolby Atmos. Its usual street price is **$900–$1,000**, so a holiday price at **$900 or less** is a genuine deal. It lacks DTS:X and has a single HDMI eARC port. Adding Era 100 rears and a Sub 4 later is where Sonos gets expensive; see the [Sonos home theater setup](/sonos-home-theater-review/).

An **11.1.4** system with sub and rear speakers in the box, scoring **87/100**. Usual street price **$1,500–$2,000**; target **$1,500 or less**. It suits buyers who want real rear speakers without a receiver.

sections.heading: When is Cyber Monday 2026?
sections.body: **Monday, November 30, 2026.** Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, and Black Friday is Friday, November 27. Many retailers run the same prices from Black Friday through Cyber Monday, so if a bar is already at or under its target on Black Friday, there is little reason to wait.

sections.heading: How do you tell a real soundbar deal from a fake one?
sections.body:
- **Compare with the usual price, not the list price.** Many "was" prices are a list price the bar rarely sells at.
- **Check the exact model number.** Some retailers sell versions with different model numbers and bundles; compare the spec sheet.
- **Count what is in the box.** A bar plus sub plus rears at one price can beat a cheaper bar you have to expand later.
- **Check the return window.** Holiday purchases often get extended returns; confirm on the receipt.

sections.heading: Which soundbar should you buy on Cyber Monday?
sections.body:
Match the bar to the room before the price:

- **Small room or bedroom:** [Sonos Beam (Gen 2)](/gear/sonos-beam-gen-2/) or [Bose Smart Soundbar](/gear/bose-smart-soundbar/).
- **Living room, single bar:** [Sonos Arc Ultra](/gear/sonos-arc-ultra/) or [Bose Smart Ultra](/gear/bose-smart-ultra-soundbar/).
- **Real surround without a receiver:** [Samsung HW-Q990F](/gear/samsung-hw-q990f/) or [Polk MagniFi Max AX SR](/gear/polk-magnifi-max-ax-sr/).
- **Tight budget:** [Vizio Elevate](/gear/vizio-elevate-se-sl512x/) or [Hisense AX5120G](/gear/hisense-ax5120g/).

The full ranking is in the [best soundbar for home theater](/best-soundbar-for-home-theater/). If your current bar has stopped working, try the [soundbar no-sound fixes](/soundbar-no-sound-hdmi-arc-earc/) before replacing it.

mistakes.title: Buying the biggest discount instead of the right bar
mistakes.body: A large percentage off a bar that is too small for your room is still the wrong bar.

mistakes.title: Trusting the 'was' price
mistakes.body: Compare against the usual street price, not the list price shown next to the sale.

mistakes.title: Ignoring the TV connection
mistakes.body: Lossless Atmos from a Blu-ray player through the TV needs eARC on both ends. Check your TV before paying for it.

faqs.q: Is Cyber Monday or Black Friday better for soundbars?
faqs.a: They are often the same. If a bar is at or below its target price on Black Friday, buy it then; waiting rarely brings it lower.

faqs.q: What is a good Cyber Monday price for the Sonos Arc Ultra?
faqs.a: $900 or less, the bottom of its usual $900–$1,000 street price.

faqs.q: What is a good deal on the Sonos Beam (Gen 2)?
faqs.a: $400 or less, the bottom of its usual $400–$500 street price.

faqs.q: Do you list live sale prices?
faqs.a: No. Prices change hourly, so this page gives targets from the usual street price we track. Check the retailer's current price before you buy.
